title: City Council District 7
statement: With the second quarterly audit cycle underway for the Temescal Community Health Center, District 7 is maintaining rigorous oversight on clinical verification and expenditure tracking. With $16,615,384.6 remaining in the operational budget, our priority remains ensuring every dollar directly addresses patient care across Temescal, Rockridge, and KONO with verified intake data and complete fiscal transparency.
numberMoved: Advanced the second quarterly audit review and operational tracking for the Temescal Community Health Center.
